description: Dear Casper,I am writing as a concerned citizen of Wyoming and parent of a child in public school. In the 2025 legislative session, House Bill 199 passed. This bill was sponsored by Ocean Andrew. HB199, or the Wyoming Freedom Scholarship Act, gives $7,000 per child to any family that chooses not to have their child or children in public school. title: Letter to the Editor 6/29/2025: Wyoming’s school voucher law is unconstitutional
